title: GameSquare Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: GameSquare Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 14, 2026 disclosing amendments to its bylaws reducing the quorum requirement from a majority to one-third of votes, and setting the 2026 Annual Meeting for June 18, 2026 with a record date of April 23, 2026. The source also mentions a press release about an increase in the stock repurchase program, but the body was truncated before this item was detailed. The source is not relevant to market structure or macro catalysts as it concerns only a single micro-cap company's internal governance procedures.
key_points: GameSquare Holdings amended its bylaws on April 10, 2026 to reduce quorum requirement from majority to one-third of voting shares
The amendment was motivated by brokerage firms increasingly opting out of discretionary voting of street-name shares
2026 Annual Meeting scheduled for June 18, 2026 with record date April 23, 2026
Stockholder proposal deadlines reset due to meeting date change of more than 30 days from prior year
Rule 14a-8 proposals must be received by April 24, 2026; other nominations by May 22, 2026
